title: Austin Expands Human Rights Body
summary:
*   **Expand Human Relations Commission:** The city aimed to increase the Human Relations Commission's membership from 15 to 21.
*   **Appoint New Commissioners:** New individuals were to be named to the expanded Human Relations Commission.
*   **Fill Board Vacancy:** An appointment was also on the agenda to fill an open position on the Board of Adjustment.
transcript:
=CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 25th day of
October, 1967, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, at 10:00
A. M. for the purpose of amending the Human Relations Ordinance to increase the number of
membership from 15 to 21; to name the members of the Commission; and to make appointment
to the Board of Adjustment to fill a vacancy. s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
ATTEST:
s/ Elsie Woosley
